ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

4. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

5. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

6. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

10. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)

   B. Where is the library?

   D. Where is the Library
